mapper.sql: r.id, r.sample_id, r.parameter_id, r.value, r.unit, r.spec_min, r.spec_max, r.verdict, r.status, r.entered_by, r.entered_at, r.reviewed_by, r.reviewed_at, r.reject_reason, r.replaces_id, p.code AS parameter_code, p.name AS parameter_name, p.active AS parameter_active
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO test_result (sample_id, parameter_id, value, unit, spec_min, spec_max, verdict, status, entered_by, entered_at, replaces_id) VALUES (#{sampleId}, #{parameterId}, #{value}, #{unit}, #{specMin,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{specMax,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{verdict}, #{status}, #{enteredBy}, #{enteredAt}, #{replacesId,jdbcType=BIGINT})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM test_result r JOIN test_parameter p ON p.id = r.parameter_id WHERE r.id = #{id}

SELECT , row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY r.parameter_id ORDER BY r.id) AS attempt_no FROM test_result r JOIN test_parameter p ON p.id = r.parameter_id WHERE r.sample_id = #{sampleId} ORDER BY p.display_order, r.id

SELECT r.id FROM test_result r WHERE r.sample_id = #{sampleId} AND r.parameter_id = #{parameterId} AND r.status = 'REJECTED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM test_result n WHERE n.replaces_id = r.id) ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT 1
